### Free-text responses

```{r}
#| echo: false
source(file.path(book_root, "R/recodes/genAI3_recode.R"))

data_coded <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = FILTER,
  question_code = "genAI3",
  recode_map = genAI3_recode_map,
  header = "AI Tools",
  other = TRUE,
  cache_id = "genAI3"
)

data_coded$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
